approval_reference: Robert Velarde authorized measured CI bottleneck investigation and a separately reviewable evidence-based advisory cost correction in #2419, fresh exact bindings and policy-only seal, unchanged tests/assertions/identities, scheduler, required workflows, timeout, acquisition and model behavior. No acquisition, inference, trust activation, storage changes, merge, deployment or wagering.

restore_fields.revision_basis: October 11 current-main and PR #2416 attempt 1 completed JUnit; cancelled attempts 1/2 retained separately as incomplete observations. Scheduling only; no exclusions or changes to tests, scheduler, workflows or limits. Revision3 incorporates same-code completed refresh1 shards2/3 and all-node cancelled shard1 as explicitly estimated inter-outcome intervals; no cancelled outcome is a completed JUnit measurement.
